_doc: RAZORFIN tail (robot_shark.glb). World after import: Z up, Y = nose (-4.7) to tail (7.8), X = width. The body narrows to its caudal peduncle at y 4.5-5.5 (x within 0.75) and the fin runs y 5.5-8; everything aft of y 4.3 is the Tail, hinged there. The baked 'bolla' bubble spheres are dropped: the shark streams its own bubbles in code. tools/blender/split_regions.py
